_about: An appeal to the BIA from an immigration judge's decision (src/bia.py; 8 CFR 1003.38; the EOIR-26 instructions, Rev. Mar. 2026): the EOIR-27 and the EOIR-26, then a copy of the judge's decision and any attachments to item 6. Attorneys e-file it in ECAS. No cover letter. The fee receipt from the EOIR Payment Portal (or Form EOIR-26A) goes with it. The attorney approves titles and order.
title: Appeal to the BIA (EOIR-26 and EOIR-27)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

handwork.text: The EOIR Payment Portal receipt for the appeal fee (epay.eoir.justice.gov: the A-Number and the filing type), or Form EOIR-26A.
A copy of the judge's decision being appealed (the EOIR-26, item 5).
E-file in ECAS so the Board RECEIVES it by the deadline (no mailbox rule) then mark the appeal step done on the case page.

exhibits.title: The immigration judge's decision appealed, and the court record
Attachments to item 6 (with certified English translations)
